remarks: Welcome to 25 Patricia Lane, where timeless elegance meets modern convenience. Nestled on a highly desirable street in Darien, this 2006 Hemingway built pristine 5-bedroom, 4 full and 2 half-bath Colonial offers over 5,700 square feet of beautifully designed living space. Step inside to discover a bright, airy layout with exceptional flow, perfect for both everyday living and entertaining. The heart of the home is the stunning white eat in kitchen and great family room with fireplace, ideal for todays lifestyle. Retreat to the luxurious primary suite, complete with two expansive walk-in closets and large bath, while spacious additional bedrooms ensure comfort for all. A finished basement and third floor provide endless flexibility-think bedroom, playroom, home gym, or office space.  Beyond the home itself, the location is second to none. Situated in the coveted Hindley school district, this property also boasts unparalleled walkability. Walk or bike to nearby Darien beaches and Great Island, or take advantage of the close proximity to Darien's charming shops, restaurants, and train. Outside, the flat, level yard invites outdoor fun and relaxation. Impeccably maintained and flooded with natural light, this home is ready to welcome you. Don't miss the opportunity to live on one of Darien's most sought-after streets!
